# Launch Screen Assets

You can customize the launch screen with your own desired assets by replacing the image files in this directory.

From the `ui/` directory, you can also do it by opening your Flutter project's Xcode project with `open ios/Runner.xcworkspace`, selecting `Runner/Assets.xcassets` in the Project Navigator and dropping in the desired images.

See the [Flutter client guide](../../../../README.md) for application setup and tests. These assets customize the iOS launch screen only; web is the primary validated client, and iOS scaffolding is not a verified release.
